feature: Foundry 14 Region movement compatibility and stable creature doctrine

observedFailure.message: Region behaviors require manual movement: Rocks, Water
observedFailure.effect: All movement candidates were removed, so distant ogres and kobolds could Seek, draw equipment, or end turns without engaging.

rootCauses: Foundry 14 stored the custom Water behavior as pf2e-tactical-movement.water while the runtime recognized only the legacy water type.
The unsupported movement guard treated native adjustDarknessLevel and other non-route presentation behaviors as arbitrary movement scripts.
A ready ranged sidearm could suppress melee-primary classification and assign an ogre to a ranged firing line.

implemented.water: Recognize the Foundry 14 namespaced Water document type and retain read compatibility for legacy water documents.
implemented.regions: Allow native darkness, active-effect, scrolling-text, pause, weather and toggle behaviors while retaining guards for level changes, teleports, macros and unknown scripts.
implemented.doctrine: Keep explicit melee, ranged and caster profile doctrine stable across equipment state changes and expose that doctrine to the team coordinator.
implemented.regressions: Cover namespaced and legacy Water, harmless and unknown Region behaviors, and an ogre holding a javelin at long range.
